    <style>
    /* ===== RESET & NORMALIZE ===== */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
    body { min-height: 100vh; overflow-x: hidden; }
    img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    ul, ol { list-style: none; }
    button { cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; font: inherit; }

    /* ===== CSS VARIABLES ===== */
    :root {
      /* Colors */
      --color-bg:            #f2f4f6;
      --color-bg-alt:        #e8ecef;
      --color-surface:       #ffffff;
      --color-dark:          #0d1117;
      --color-dark-alt:      #161c26;
      --color-dark-card:     #1a2233;

      --color-teal:          #00b4a6;
      --color-teal-light:    #00d4c4;
      --color-teal-dark:     #008a7e;
      --color-teal-muted:    rgba(0, 180, 166, 0.12);

      --color-text-primary:  #0d1117;
      --color-text-secondary:#4a5568;
      --color-text-muted:    #718096;
      --color-text-light:    #f2f4f6;
      --color-text-on-dark:  #c8d6e5;

      /* Borders */
      --border-radius:       0px;
      --border-color:        #d1d9e0;
      --border-dark:         rgba(255,255,255,0.08);

      /* Shadows */
      --shadow-sm:           0 1px 4px rgba(13,17,23,0.08);
      --shadow-md:           0 4px 16px rgba(13,17,23,0.10);
      --shadow-lg:           0 8px 32px rgba(13,17,23,0.14);
      --shadow-teal:         0 4px 24px rgba(0,180,166,0.18);

      /* Glassmorphism */
      --glass-bg:            rgba(242,244,246,0.72);
      --glass-blur:          blur(18px);
      --glass-border:        1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.55);

      /* Typography */
      --font-sans:           'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --font-size-base:      1rem;
      --line-height-base:    1.6;

      /* Spacing */
      --section-pad-y:       4rem;
      --container-max:       1200px;
      --container-pad:       1.25rem;
    }

    /* ===== BASE ===== */
    body {
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: var(--font-size-base);
      line-height: var(--line-height-base);
      background-color: var(--color-bg);
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
    }

    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: var(--container-max);
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding-inline: var(--container-pad);
    }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--color-teal);
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    /* ===== HEADER ===== */
    #header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: var(--glass-bg);
      backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
      border-bottom: var(--glass-border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
      min-height: 64px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding-block: 0.5rem;
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--color-dark);
      white-space: nowrap;
      min-height: 44px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .logo span {
      color: var(--color-teal);
    }

    /* Mobile nav toggle */
    .nav-toggle {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 5px;
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      padding: 8px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .nav-toggle span {
      display: block;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--color-dark);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* Nav */
    .nav-wrapper {
      display: none;
      width: 100%;
      order: 3;
      padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .nav-wrapper.open { display: block; }

    .main-nav {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.25rem;
    }

    .main-nav a {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
      border-left: 2px solid transparent;
    }

    .main-nav a:hover {
      color: var(--color-teal);
      background: var(--color-teal-muted);
      border-left-color: var(--color-teal);
    }

    /* Language switcher */
    .lang-switcher {
      position: relative;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
    }

    .lang-toggle {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      background: var(--color-surface);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
      width: fit-content;
    }

    .lang-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--color-teal); color: var(--color-teal); }

    .lang-toggle svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; transition: transform 0.2s; }
    .lang-toggle.open svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }

    .lang-dropdown {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 4px);
      left: 0;
      background: var(--color-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      z-index: 200;
      min-width: 160px;
      max-height: 280px;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .lang-dropdown.open { display: block; }

    .lang-dropdown a {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      min-height: 36px;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    }

    .lang-dropdown a:hover { background: var(--color-teal-muted); color: var(--color-teal); }
    .lang-dropdown a.active { color: var(--color-teal); font-weight: 700; background: var(--color-teal-muted); }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    #hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100svh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0d1117 0%, #0a2a2a 40%, #003d38 70%, #00b4a6 100%);
    }

    .hero-grid-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(0,180,166,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,180,166,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 48px 48px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-glow {
      position: absolute;
      width: 60vw;
      height: 60vw;
      max-width: 700px;
      max-height: 700px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,180,166,0.22) 0%, transparent 70%);
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      text-align: center;
      padding-block: 5rem 4rem;
    }

    .hero-eyebrow {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.22em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--color-teal-light);
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,196,0.3);
      padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
    }

    #hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 7vw, 4.5rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      color: #ffffff;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    #hero h1 .accent { color: var(--color-teal-light); }

    .hero-sub {
      font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 2.5vw, 1.2rem);
      color: var(--color-text-on-dark);
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .hero-cta-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 48px;
      padding: 0.75rem 2rem;
      background: var(--color-teal);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--color-teal-dark);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-teal);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-ghost {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 48px;
      padding: 0.75rem 2rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
    }

    .btn-ghost:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-teal-light);
      background: rgba(0,180,166,0.1);
    }

    .hero-stats {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-top: 3.5rem;
      padding-top: 2.5rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }

    .hero-stat {
      text-align: center;
    }

    .hero-stat strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.2rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--color-teal-light);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .hero-stat span {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--color-text-on-dark);
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* ===== VISION ===== */
    #vision {
      padding-block: var(--section-pad-y);
      background: var(--color-surface);
    }

    .vision-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 2.5rem;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .vision-text h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      color: var(--color-dark);
    }

    .vision-text h2 .accent { color: var(--color-teal); }

    .vision-text p {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      max-width: 520px;
    }

    .vision-pillars {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 1.5rem;
    }

    .pillar-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
      border-left: 3px solid var(--color-teal);
      background: var(--color-bg);
    }

    .pillar-item .pillar-icon {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--color-teal);
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .pillar-item strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-dark);
      margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    }

    .pillar-item p {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
      margin: 0;
    }

    .vision-visual {
      position: relative;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-dark) 0%, #003d38 100%);
      padding: 2.5rem;
      min-height: 280px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .vision-visual::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(0,180,166,0.08) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,180,166,0.08) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 32px 32px;
    }

    .vision-visual-label {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--color-teal);
      font-weight: 700;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .vision-metric {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .vision-metric strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 8vw, 4rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #ffffff;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .vision-metric span {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--color-text-on-dark);
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* ===== ECOSYSTEM ===== */
    #ecosystem {
      padding-block: var(--section-pad-y);
      background: var(--color-bg);
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }

    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      color: var(--color-dark);
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .section-header h2 .accent { color: var(--color-teal); }

    .section-header p {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      max-width: 540px;
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    /* Bento Grid */
    .bento-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .bento-card {
      background: var(--color-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }

    .bento-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .bento-card::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 3px;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--color-teal);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
    }

    .bento-card:hover::after { opacity: 1; }

    .bento-card.featured {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-dark) 0%, #003d38 100%);
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .bento-card.featured::after { opacity: 1; }

    .bento-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--color-teal-muted);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      color: var(--color-teal);
    }

    .bento-card.featured .bento-icon {
      background: rgba(0,180,166,0.2);
    }

    .bento-card h3 {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      color: var(--color-dark);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .bento-card.featured h3 { color: #ffffff; }

    .bento-card p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .bento-card.featured p { color: var(--color-text-on-dark); }

    .bento-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--color-teal);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-teal);
      padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
    }

    /* ===== INNOVATION ===== */
    #innovation {
      padding-block: var(--section-pad-y);
      background: var(--color-dark);
    }

    #innovation .section-header h2 { color: #ffffff; }
    #innovation .section-header p { color: var(--color-text-on-dark); }

    .feature-cards {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: var(--color-dark-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-teal);
      box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(0,180,166,0.12);
    }

    .feature-number {
      font-size: 3rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: rgba(0,180,166,0.12);
      line-height: 1;
      position: absolute;
      top: 1rem;
      right: 1.25rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .feature-card h3 {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ffffff;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .feature-card p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--color-text-on-dark);
      line-height: 1.6;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .feature-card ul {
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.35rem;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .feature-card ul li {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--color-text-on-dark);
      padding-left: 1rem;
      position: relative;
    }

    .feature-card ul li::before {
      content: '—';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      color: var(--color-teal);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* ===== PHILOSOPHY ===== */
    #philosophy {
      padding-block: var(--section-pad-y);
      background: var(--color-surface);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .philosophy-bg-text {
      position: absolute;
      font-size: clamp(5rem, 18vw, 14rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: rgba(0,180,166,0.04);
      white-space: nowrap;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      pointer-events: none;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      line-height: 1;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .philosophy-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .philosophy-inner h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--color-dark);
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .philosophy-inner h2 .accent { color: var(--color-teal); }

    .philosophy-inner > p {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      max-width: 540px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }

    .values-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 1rem;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .value-card {
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      background: var(--color-bg);
      position: relative;
    }

    .value-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--color-teal);
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: left;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .value-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }

    .value-card h4 {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--color-dark);
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    }

    .value-card p {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    #footer {
      background: var(--color-dark-alt);
